findings.title: DataJud API key hardcoded in scraper/datajud.py
dangerouslySetInnerHTML used without client-side sanitization
findings.evidence: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }} /> — HTML originates from server
findings.reject_rationale: False positive — XSS risk is already mitigated server-side: routes.ts:3211-3215 and 3323-3327 apply sanitize-html with allowedSchemes:[data] before persisting or returning HTML. Client-side re-sanitization would be redundant. Residual risk is accepted.

findings.title: No helmet middleware — security headers absent
findings.evidence: app.use(express.json(...)); app.use(express.urlencoded(...)); — no helmet() call anywhere in server/index.ts

findings.title: No rate limiting on any API endpoint
findings.evidence: No rateLimit() middleware call anywhere in server/index.ts or server/routes.ts

findings.title: 3 silent catch(e) blocks swallow JSON.parse errors without logging
findings.evidence: } catch (e) { res.status(500).json({error:...}) } — no console.error before response at lines ~779, ~846, ~885

findings.title: parseInt query params without upper-bound — partial DoS risk
findings.evidence: const limit = parseInt(req.query.limit as string) || 50; — no max bound; malicious client can request arbitrarily large result sets
findings.note: Behavioral hardening: clamps limit to 1-500 and horas to 1-8760. Intentional behavior change to constrain resource consumption.

findings.title: No automated test suite configured
findings.evidence: No jest/vitest/pytest config files found; package.json has no test script beyond tsc

findings.title: CORS not explicitly configured
findings.evidence: No cors() middleware call; SPA and API share origin so impact is currently low

findings.title: Unstructured logging — 31 console.error calls without context tags
findings.evidence: grep -c console.error server/routes.ts = 31 — no log level, no request ID, no structured fields

improvements_proposed.title: Add helmet middleware for HTTP security headers
improvements_proposed.scope: server/index.ts — add app.use(helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: false })) after express.json()
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — adds X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS headers; prevents clickjacking and MIME sniffing
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing new dependency: helmet. User approval needed before modifying package.json.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Express sends no security headers by default. Helmet is the de-facto standard with zero runtime overhead. CSP disabled initially to avoid breaking Vite-injected scripts; can be tightened in a later cycle.

improvements_proposed.title: Add express-rate-limit on API endpoints — especially scraping routes
improvements_proposed.scope: server/index.ts — global limiter (100 req/min) + tighter limiter on /api/pesquisa/* and /api/consulta-processual (10 req/min)
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — prevents abuse of expensive DataJud/ScraperAPI calls, protects SCRAPER_API_KEY quota, reduces risk of cascading failures under load
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing new dependency: express-rate-limit. User approval needed.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Scraping endpoints invoke external APIs (DataJud, ScraperAPI) with usage quotas. Without rate limiting, a bot can exhaust the monthly quota in minutes.

improvements_proposed.title: Split server/routes.ts into domain-scoped route modules
improvements_proposed.scope: Create server/routes/ directory with: clientes.ts, equipe.ts, processos.ts, atividades.ts, documentos.ts, financeiro.ts, scraping.ts, dashboard.ts, acervo.ts, comunicacoes.ts, deadlines.ts. Keep server/routes.ts as thin re-exporting index.
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: MEDIUM — improves maintainability, reduces merge conflicts, enables per-domain ownership; zero behaviour change
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Large mechanical refactor (3609 lines). Must preserve exact endpoint signatures and middleware order. Recommend a dedicated cycle or background task.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Single-file architecture with 125 endpoints causes accidental coupling, slow navigation, and high conflict risk in multi-agent development.

improvements_proposed.title: Configure vitest as test runner with initial route smoke-tests
improvements_proposed.scope: Install vitest + supertest; add vitest.config.ts; add server/routes.test.ts with GET /api/clientes, GET /api/processos, GET /api/equipe smoke tests
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: HIGH — enables all future PROMETHEUS APPLY_WITH_NEW_TEST fixes; catches regressions; unblocks confidence-gated auto-apply of remaining findings
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires modifying package.json (add vitest, supertest). User approval needed. vitest.config.ts can be created without restriction.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Without a test runner, PROMETHEUS can only apply behavior-neutral fixes. 70% of potential future fixes are permanently DEFER-locked until a runner exists.

improvements_proposed.title: Add explicit CORS configuration with origin whitelist
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: LOW-MEDIUM — currently low risk (SPA and API co-hosted); becomes critical if deployment topology separates frontend from API
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing cors package OR manual implementation without new dependency. Low priority while SPA and API share origin.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Explicit CORS documents intent and prevents accidental cross-origin access if deployment topology changes.

improvements_proposed.title: Adopt structured logging (pino) — replace 31 console.error calls
improvements_proposed.scope: Install pino + pino-pretty; create server/logger.ts; replace console.error/warn/log throughout server/ with logger.error/warn/info including {requestId, path, method} context
improvements_proposed.expected_roi: MEDIUM — structured logs enable aggregation, request tracing, and faster debugging in production; pino is 5x faster than console.log
improvements_proposed.blocker_for_apply: Requires installing pino and pino-pretty. Broad change touching 31+ call sites across server/routes.ts and other server files.
improvements_proposed.rationale: Unstructured console.error in production is hard to filter, aggregate, or alert on. Structured logging is a prerequisite for observability tooling.
